Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Description: Native FFXIV Ensemble Ready Check with automatic client confirmation and game-synchronised START inspired by MidiBard 2. Includes Soulweaver Studio, chat-safe chords, optional party instrument and playlist setup, compact Performance HUD, native instrument switching, C3-C6 optimiser, smart Solo/Ensemble playlists and full-featured concert tools.
Punchline: Visual stage formation editor, concert director, SoundFont preview and native ensembles.
